# svgforge

> Diagrams as code: deterministic SVG figures with lint gates, drawn by agents. A figure is a Python spec; svgforge measures and places every label and writes a self-contained SVG, byte for byte the same on every run.

svgforge renders a folder of figure specs into SVGs, with an INDEX.json that holds each figure's full prose description, so an agent can read a figure instead of looking at it. Lint gates fail text under 11px, text outside the canvas, glyphs that render as boxes, empty alt text, a collapsed canvas and broken XML. It is standard-library Python and calls no model.

Run it from GitHub with no clone: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/naman10parikh/svgforge svgforge --help` for the command line and `uvx --from git+https://github.com/naman10parikh/svgforge svgforge-mcp` for the MCP server (stdio). Paths below are relative to the repository root.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what svgforge does, every command and MCP tool, the skills, the house rules and what not to do.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code notes (the lint hook, the development MCP config); it imports AGENTS.md.
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, the quick start and how to install it in any coding agent.
- [AUTHORING.md](AUTHORING.md): how to write a figure spec, the full drawing API and the seven house rules.

## Identity

- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who Svgforge is, what it does and what it refuses.
- [identity/BRAND.md](identity/BRAND.md): the name's reason, the tagline and the look.
- [identity/HEARTBEAT.md](identity/HEARTBEAT.md): what is checked, how often, and what happens on an anomaly.
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](.well-known/agent-card.json): the A2A agent card.

## Command line (`svgforge`)

- [src/svgforge/cli.py](src/svgforge/cli.py): the entry point. Commands:
  - `svgforge build [figures] [--out diagrams] [--only ID ...] [--check] [--json]`: render, lint, and write INDEX.json and a gallery; `--check` fails on stale files.
  - `svgforge lint FILE.svg ... [--json]`: run the lint gates on any SVG.
  - `svgforge demo [--out DIR]`: render the three bundled example figures.
  - `svgforge find TERMS ... [--index FILE]` and `svgforge show ID [--index FILE]`: search and read a figure store.
  - `svgforge route "TASK"`: the skill and the command for a task.
  - `svgforge runs [--last N]`: the run log.

## MCP server (`svgforge-mcp`, stdio)

- [src/svgforge/mcp_server.py](src/svgforge/mcp_server.py): five tools:
  - `svgforge_list`: every figure's id, title and document.
  - `svgforge_get`: one figure's record with its full alt text.
  - `svgforge_search`: figures whose title or alt text holds every term.
  - `svgforge_lint`: the lint gates on a file or an SVG string.
  - `svgforge_build`: render a folder of specs, or check it for stale files.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the config any MCP client can copy; it starts the server from GitHub. The development config is `.mcp.dev.json`.

## Engine

- [src/svgforge/canvas.py](src/svgforge/canvas.py): the Canvas: cards, bands, arrows, sequences, curves, fans, layer bands, brackets.
- [src/svgforge/tokens.py](src/svgforge/tokens.py): colours, tones and the glyphs that render as boxes.
- [src/svgforge/text.py](src/svgforge/text.py): the width table, measuring and wrapping.
- [src/svgforge/lint.py](src/svgforge/lint.py): the seven lint rules.
- [src/svgforge/build.py](src/svgforge/build.py): loading specs, rendering, INDEX.json and the gallery.
- [src/svgforge/examples/](src/svgforge/examples/): the three example specs (pipeline, loop, stack).

## Skills

- [skills/draw-a-figure/SKILL.md](skills/draw-a-figure/SKILL.md): draw a new figure, from search to a lint-clean SVG that has been looked at.
- [skills/ascii-to-figure/SKILL.md](skills/ascii-to-figure/SKILL.md): turn an ASCII diagram in a document into a figure, keeping every fact.
- [skills/figure-review/SKILL.md](skills/figure-review/SKILL.md): review figures for legibility and honesty, ending in a verdict table.

## Sub-agents

- [.claude/agents/figure-author.md](.claude/agents/figure-author.md): writes or updates a spec and renders it.
- [.claude/agents/figure-critic.md](.claude/agents/figure-critic.md): reviews rendered figures and changes nothing.

## Memory

- [memory/MEMORY.md](memory/MEMORY.md): the short bootstrap: invariants, where things are, decisions.
- [memory/LEARNINGS.md](memory/LEARNINGS.md): every mistake, written as a rule.
- [scripts/memory_search.py](scripts/memory_search.py): BM25 search over the memory, identity, skills and guides.

## Evals and self-improvement

- [evals/run.py](evals/run.py): structural checks, golden tasks and an MCP round trip; exits 1 on any failure.
- [evals/golden.json](evals/golden.json): the golden tasks for the lint gates.
- [evals/loop.py](evals/loop.py): the nightly loop: evals, a corpus read, and proposals; it never commits.
- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract.
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): tests and evals on every push and pull request.
- [.github/workflows/loop.yml](.github/workflows/loop.yml): the scheduled loop; it opens or updates one issue when it has a proposal.

- [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json): the plugin's hook, the lint gate after Write and Edit.
- [gemini-extension.json](gemini-extension.json): the Gemini CLI extension.
